title: Schemes locally of finite type over a field are Jacobson
statement: Let $k$ be a field and let $X$ be a scheme locally of finite type over $k$ [def-weil-finite-type-morphism]. For every closed subset $Z\subseteq X$, the set of closed points of $X$ [def-weil-closed-points] lying in $Z$ is dense in $Z$.
